title: DerivativeCreated
description: Content was written from assets already put in. The relay understands this type natively, which is why it exists beside generation.ready: this one says a derivative was made, that one hands over what it says. Keys are snake_case, not the camelCase the rest of leaf uses: this travels inside a Liquid envelope, whose own fields (event_id, occurred_at, event_type, owner_unit_ref) are snake_case and pinned byte-exact by signed golden vectors. The shape follows the wire.

template.description: Which template it was written from. Free text: the templates belong to whoever generates.

session_id.description: The working session it was made in.

source_assets.description: The assets it was written from, by id. Absent when nothing was drawn on.
